item.title: Unchecked cd commands silently continue in wrong directory
item.intent: Every cd in the orchestrator must fail loudly — silently running git or file operations in the wrong directory can corrupt repos or lose work.
item.description: Several cd commands use '2>/dev/null || true', suppressing errors. If cd fails, subsequent git/file operations execute in the wrong directory. Affected lines: cd $PROJECT_ROOT, cd $wt_dir, and others. Replace with explicit error checks that return/exit on failure.
steps: Find all cd commands in .aishore/aishore that use || true or 2>/dev/null
Replace with: cd "$dir" || { log_error "Cannot cd to $dir"; return 1; }
Verify no cd command silently ignores failure

acceptanceCriteria.text: No cd command uses || true or suppresses stderr without an error handler
All cd commands have explicit failure handling
acceptanceCriteria.verify: ! grep -En '^\s+cd ' .aishore/aishore | grep -v '|| {' | grep -v 'log_error' | grep -v '|| return' | grep -v '|| exit' | grep -qv '#'
